meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 这个技能会把旧版NanoClaw和Claude留下的记忆文件搬到统一的记忆文件夹,并整理成标准格式。它先暂停相关任务、移动文件,再分类内容,最后生成一份迁移报告供你确认。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate memory”等触发词,或遇到更新后记忆失效、旧版记忆文件残留时触发。

say.text: 帮我把旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树。
say.note: 会先清点受影响的组并请求批准。

say.text: 处理一下遗留的 CLAUDE.md 和自动记忆。
say.note: 会移动并分类这些旧文件。

say.text: 智能体切换后忘了一切,请迁移记忆。

howto.what_en: This skill moves legacy NanoClaw and Claude memory files into a unified memory folder and organizes them into a standard format. It pauses tasks, moves files, classifies content, then produces a migration report for approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate memory" or similar, or after an update leaves shared memory broken or legacy memory files behind.

say_en.text: Migrate legacy memory into the shared memory tree.
say_en.note: It will list affected groups and ask approval first.

say_en.text: Handle the leftover CLAUDE.md and auto-memory.
say_en.note: It moves and classifies these old files.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch; migrate memory.
